claim_scope: Train-only oracle capacity diagnostic on one development Marmousi record. Future truth deliberately selects coefficients only to measure the correction span; the coefficients are forbidden for online adaptation or deployment.
hypothesis: If the 63-dimensional learned branch-trunk pressure span is adequate and only the two-frame online objective is misaligned, a full-401 train-truth oracle solve inside the identical span will reduce future-field relative L2 by at least 1% under the same 5% correction-ratio cap.
expected_mechanism: The oracle removes online-objective ambiguity and measures whether the learned branch-trunk modes themselves contain a future-error-aligned direction.
primary_metric: Trust-capped oracle future-field relative-L2 improvement over the unadapted update-13650 prediction.

acceptance.interpretation_if_pass: retain the basis and redesign or meta-learn the online coefficient objective
acceptance.interpretation_if_fail: reject branch-trunk contributions as the sole correction basis and learn a future-error basis offline

failure_signal: Reject the diagnostic on binding drift, non-finite output, effective-rank failure, non-train truth, process failure, or any validation/test_id access.

oracle.basis: same Gram-whitened branch-trunk span used by the failed two-onset Transfer-DG smoke
oracle.objective: weighted leading-64-bin coefficient error from complete train truth

rollback: This diagnostic does not change the parent or any adapter. Preserve all checkpoints and discard oracle coefficients after reporting span capacity.
